name: Villaherreros (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of blue, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villaherreros (a hammer and anvil on white and crossed keys on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Villaherreros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villaherreros arms — hammer and anvil on white, crossed keys on blue
